title: SOCBench artifact pins
description: One file per source under manifests/: the files the adapter fetches, the checksum upstream publishes (if any), and the SHA-256 this project recorded when it last fetched them. A pinned sha256 is what `jef-bench check` compares the local cache against; null means never fetched here.

name.description: File name inside the source's data directory. No path separators.

upstream_checksum.description: As published by the source, algorithm-prefixed (md5:..., sha1:..., git:<commit>). Recorded for cross-checking, never trusted in place of our own sha256.
